paper.title_en: Colored Black Holes in Logarithmic Nonlinear Yang--Mills Theory
paper.abstract_en: We construct static, spherically symmetric, and asymptotically flat colored black holes in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to a logarithmic nonlinear Yang--Mills field with gauge group SU(2). Unlike solutions based on the Wu--Yang ansatz, the gauge sector contains a dynamical radial amplitude, and the configurations arise from a genuinely coupled nonlinear boundary-value problem. An integral identity excludes nontrivial sign-definite solutions approaching a magnetically neutral Yang--Mills vacuum, implying that colored configurations must be nodal. We numerically construct the fundamental one-node branch and verify its convergence to the ordinary Einstein--Yang--Mills colored black hole in the linear limit. Increasing the logarithmic nonlinearity lowers the ADM mass, raises the Hawking temperature, and displaces the gauge-field node toward larger radii. Branch termination is not detected over the full range of parameters investigated. Instead, the exterior geometry approaches Schwarzschild on fixed radial domains, while the colored structure develops an increasingly extended tail. Although no independent asymptotic Yang--Mills charge is present, the non-Abelian hair leaves a subleading imprint on the far-field geometry. Inside the event horizon, the representative nonlinear solutions possess no Cauchy horizon and approach a Schwarzschild-type spacelike curvature singularity, with a finite limiting mass and no oscillary mass inflation. The recovery of the linear theory is therefore nonuniform near the cetonter: solutions that are nearly linear in the exterior eventually enter the strongly logarithmic regime in the deep interior. Finally, turning points of the Hawking temperature produce divergences and sign changes in heat capacity, indicating transitions of local thermodynamic stability.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了广义相对论中非阿贝尔规范场下的黑洞解，涉及数值构造、热力学性质和内部结构，符合广义相对论基础及黑洞热力学相关领域，具有较高的理论深度和前沿性。
decision.title_zh: 对数非线性杨-米尔斯理论中的彩色黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在规范群SU(2)下，由爱因斯坦引力耦合一个对数非线性杨-米尔斯场，构造了四维爱因斯坦引力中静态、球对称且渐近平坦的彩色黑洞。与基于吴-杨（Wu-Yang）拟设的解不同，规范场部分包含一个动态的径向振幅，这些构型来自于一个真正耦合的非线性边值问题。一个积分恒等式排除了非平凡的正负号确定解趋近于磁中性的杨-米尔斯真空，这意味着彩色构型必须是节点的。我们数值构建了基本的单节点分支，并验证了它在线性极限下收敛到普通的爱因斯坦-杨-米尔斯彩色黑洞。增加对数非线性会降低ADM质量，提高霍金温度，并将规范场节点移向更大的半径。在所研究的完整参数范围内，未检测到分支终止。相反，外部几何在固定径向域上趋近于史瓦西（Schwarzschild）解，而彩色结构发展出越来越长的尾部。尽管没有独立的渐近杨-米尔斯电荷，非阿贝尔毛发在远场几何上留下了次主导的印记。在事件视界内部，代表性的非线性解没有柯西视界，并趋近于一个类史瓦西的类空曲率奇点，具有有限的极限质量且没有振荡质量膨胀。因此，线性理论的恢复在中心附近是非均匀的：在外部接近线性的解最终在深内部进入强对数区域。最后，霍金温度的转折点导致热容量的发散和符号变化，表明局部热力学稳定性的转变。
